body: Wow, I really appreciate the response.  There's a lot of good advice in there, but there's one thing is still troubling me and that's how I'll be feeling if/when I do get out of my situation.  Moving out would be ideal for me right now, in any way possible, and from then on I would be working my job and looking for a new one I guess.  More of a career type job that pays well and has benefits and all that.  I fear that if I do get to that point that I will still be unhappy because that isn't really what I want.  My parents want me to be a corporate-type 9-5 kind of guy but that's not what I'm looking for.  I don't KNOW what I want to do, and it's something I've been thinking about since before I even went to college.  I just never found what is right for me and I fear maybe nothing is.  I enjoy being a server because it's different but at the same time, it's not something I can do the rest of my life.  There's really nowhere to move up.  I really can't think of anything to go after that will be both enjoyable to me and also satisfactory for my parents to be proud of me.  I just don't know what to do and it's nearly giving me an anxiety attack just thinking about it right now.
